confidence: FIELD. A real worn WHOOP 5.0/MG per-second record (type 47, version 18) captured on hardware and committed with only biometrics + timestamp (no serial/name/token). Version 18 rides the second inner byte (inner[1]); the third byte is the on-wrist r22 command 0x80. Admitted fields reproduce byte-for-byte: HR 102 at body[11], skin temp 3057 (i16 LE centidegrees) at body[62:64], sleep state 0 (bits 5-4 of body[70]). The awake capture carries SpO2 0 (sleep-only), so the tri-mode SpO2 byte stays unadmitted here as intended. Still owes a check on our own strap in the hardware epoch.
source: tanarchytan/whoop-rs, crates/whoop-protocol/tests/fixtures/real_frames.json, frame 'v18_real_whoop5_worn'. Real drained capture, author-validated against ground truth; imported as Maverick's golden fixture in place of the earlier synthetic one, which encoded the version in the wrong inner byte.
